reviews.review: I have always loved this game from when it initially came out.  Sure it has its bugs, but personally I always found this one of the Mass Effect series to be the best and my favorite.  I will continue playing this game, and maybe, somewhere down the line, this game would be remade, but that's just being hopeful at this point.

I've finished previous ME games about two times (liked them very much) and now this one for the first time (in about 40 hours). All relation ship quests completed, main story line and some sidequests. It's not a bad game, but honetly it's a loading screen festival. The engine looks so old, it almost made me cry (and that is stark contrast to the main storyline quest, which completely lacks any sort of emotion or ingenuity). No sacrifices had to be made to finish the game. 

Only actual sacrifice was to endure all the loading screens, during some quest you'd spend 90% of time on a loading screen and 10% doing something. Oh and one more thing, the damned loading screen don't even go anywhere, even the map (which is like 9 small balls per average with some fancy looking backgrounds) has its own  loading screens! Why I wonder, why...

Where do I even start?

- Combat/Gameplay was great, much more engaging I'd say than the OT. 
- Story was frankly a snoozefest topped by a few unlikeable companions (*cough Liam *cough). Peebee was redeemable with mods at least. 
- Voice acting and facial animations..... the less said, the better. Honestly, just pretend I did not bother listing this at all. 

My chief complaint, as someone trying to get all achievements, is that I'm having difficulty actually liking the companions enough to even consider romancing them. I struggled hard in the OT to pick who NOT to romance and ended up using random.org to pick. Andromeda was a whole different struggle entirely in the opposite direction.

It's a shame its been abandoned at this point. Get it on sale or on a bundle (Humble, Fanatical, whatever) for under $5 and no more than that.

My first impression upon playing this game at release in 2017 was that it was a Boring game. And as an ardent fan of the ME series, that was disappointment. And after playing a heavily-modded version of the game in 2025 I would merely add Flawed and Bloated to my original sentiment. So not a Bad game per se, but far from Great. Overall Rating: 7/10.

Pros:

-Solid combat with customization of playstyle in regards to weapons, mods, augments, powers and tech abilities

-Decent RPG with some choices, but none that really matter

-Solid graphics


Cons:

-Bloated game; for although I like open-world / large region games, they should serve a purpose. There is just too much bloat, and most of it isn't needed.

-Companions, a hallmark of the ME Trilogy games, are meh. There are a few stand-out moments, here and there, but overall they are bland.

-Story is generic / recycled. In the Trilogy you have the Collectors: a squashed-head species. But they are merely Protheans. And in this game you have Kett, a squashed-head species; but they're merely Angara. It's like they can't come up with anything original.

-It's using Frostbite so all the issues with the engine (I.e. fake reload) are present; in addition they have a jet-pack but because the engine can't detect properly when you are adjacent to a vaulting / mantling / grabbing area, you constantly just up and try to grab a ledge, only to fall to your death when you can't grab it.

Ryder is a P?#!y and can't form his own leading command. I went in expecting  a commander sheperd reincarnation  but I was thoroughly disappointed. I tried liking him, but the characters around him don't have the charm from previous titles either and are overbearing to deal with. I tried putting up with all that but the amount of insane side quests compared to the previous titles just puts me off. I'd rather replay the previous titles than continue with this.
